reason: the performance lens's findings the code or a test must fix

findings.text: performance lens, high: `cycle_dispatch_stage` emits a flock-protected `stage.start` disk write on every cycle-member dispatch at every iteration of every fresh run, not only during resume, because the guard `_cd_iter > 0` is always true for cycle-member calls. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:3204; fix: code)

performance lens, medium: `_runner_from_stage_preflight` calls `_find_plugin_for_stage` (which runs `discover_plugins_into` — a full plugin-directory scan reading every manifest) in a command substitution for each stage before the target, so for N pre-target stages there are N full plugin-directory scans (O(N×P) manifest reads) on the `--from-stage` startup path. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:1757; fix: code)

performance lens, medium: `get_state_field` is called once per top-level dispatch unit (cycle:* and stage:*) during resume; each call spawns two subprocesses — `jq empty` for validation plus `jq -r` for the read — re-reading and re-validating the same state file for every unit instead of loading the status map once at resume entry. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:3482; fix: code)
